description: Land Acquisition - Bakmeegolla, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government, including lot numbers, land names, extents, locations, and claimant information. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in the "PART III - LANDS" section of the gazette.
